map.BPM 和毫秒怎么互转？: How do I convert BPM and milliseconds?
map.LFO 同步频率怎么算？: How is the LFO sync frequency computed?
map.→ 打开BPM 速度转换器工具: -> Open the BPM speed converter tool
map.周期毫秒 = 四分音符毫秒 × 倍数（每拍=1、每两拍=2），频率(Hz) =: Cycle ms = quarter-note ms x multiplier (1 per beat, 2 per two beats); frequency (Hz) = 1000 / cycle ms. Once per bar (4 beats) = 1000/(500x4) = 0.5 Hz.
map.四分音符毫秒 = 60000 / BPM；已知某音符毫秒 ms，对应 BPM =: Quarter-note ms = 60000 / BPM; given the ms of a note, the matching BPM = 60000 x the beats of that note / ms (an eighth note is 0.5 beats).
map.按采样率算某音符占多少采样点，做精准切片: Work out how many sample points a note occupies at the sample rate for precise slicing
map.给 LFO/颤音设与 BPM 同步的频率（如每拍一次的滤波扫频）: Set the LFO or vibrato frequency in sync with the BPM (such as one filter sweep per beat)
map.编曲时把 BPM 转成四分音符毫秒，对齐音符网格与延迟时间: In arrangement, convert BPM into quarter-note milliseconds to align the note grid and delay times
map.：120 BPM → 四分音符 = 60000/120 = 500 ms；八分: : at 120 BPM the quarter note = 60000/120 = 500 ms; the eighth = 250 ms, the sixteenth = 125 ms and the dotted quarter = 500x1.5 = 750 ms.
map.：120 BPM 下每拍 500 ms；要 LFO 每拍一个周期，频率 = 10: : at 120 BPM each beat is 500 ms; for the LFO to complete one cycle per beat the frequency = 1000/500 = 2 Hz. At a 44100 Hz sample rate a quarter note = round(500/1000x44100) = 22050 samples.
